decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - No work shall start on site without prior written notification of the start to English Heritage with a copy to the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The proposed works shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith or as shall have been otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are occupied.

Condition : 4 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - A schedule (including reasoned justification) of repairs and works to the external fabric of the Gillette Building and the interior areas highlighted in the submitted drawings and all repairs and works to the four Grade II listed Victorian cast-iron lamp standards along Syon Lane shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to commencement of works. The schedule shall include detailed design of connections/linkages to original fabric and detailed design of adaptations/additions where these affect the appearance and/or character of the listed buildings (notwithstanding Condition 3, including details of window replacement of window frames and glass).  Any part of the listed buildings consented to be demolished or hidden by new work shall be recorded photographically and an archive noting locations kept; a copy of the annotated archive shall be provided to the Local Planning Authority (with a copy for the Twentieth Century Society) in accordance with a timetable to be approved, in advance and in writing, by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No works shall take place in any phase until detailed drawings and samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces (including eaves details, fascias, windows, balustrades and protective barriers etc and including the materials to be used in the construction of the road surfaces hereby permitted) in the Hotel (that part of the site shaded in yellow on drawing no. A-0-PR-1001 (Site Plan Proposed) (hereinafter called "the Hotel")) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding Condition 1, the works of demolition hereby approved shall not be commenced before planning permission has been granted pursuant to planning application reference 00505/AP/P74 (or any subsequent planning permission for the redevelopment of the site as may be granted) and arrangements made for procuring the works of demolition, and a contract for the carrying out of the Hotel, have been made and evidence of the same submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - No works shall commence until details of(a)	the works of conversion of the Gillette Building, including making good works following the approved demolition works; (b) 	the works of conversion of the Engineers House to the west of the Gillette Building, including making good works; (c) 	making good works to the front boundary wall along Syon Lane and its four Victorian cast-iron lamp standards; and(d)	making good works to the boundary wall running down the north-west side of the site unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The development shall not be occupied until all the works have been completed as approved.

Condition : 9 - No works shall commence until details of,(i) any works to the existing window openings of the Gillette Building including any   secondary glazing; and (ii) any replacement windows (glass and/or frame) within the Gillette Building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  All works shall be carried out as approved before the Hotel hereby permitted is occupied and retained thereafter.
description: Listed Building consent to extend the time limit for implementation of an extant planning permission for works of alteration, extension and demolition to facilitate the retention and conversion of the Gillette Building for hotel use, as part of the proposed comprehensive development of the Gillette site referenced 00505/AP/L22 dated 22/11/2007.
